manifest.visible_prompt: Should I buy this new course to get better at customer interviews?

files.bytes:
Owned course: Customer Interview Foundations (fictional)
Module 1 — recent behavior: ask about a specific recent occasion and follow the sequence of actions.
Module 2 — neutral questions: ask what happened rather than whether the customer likes a proposed solution.
Module 3 — concrete evidence: ask what was tried, the workarounds and the consequences; distinguish observed actions from opinions.
Module 4 — rehearsal: pair up, run a short interview on a supplied scenario, then review where a question led the answer or hid uncertainty.
Module 5 — review: keep observations and interpretation in separate columns; write unresolved questions.
All five modules and the rehearsal worksheet are available under the existing ownership.

Supplied rehearsal materials
Synthetic scenario: a colleague missed a delivery commitment after a conversation and used a handwritten reminder to recover it. Interviewee may answer only from this scenario; invented customer claims must be marked unknown.
Question cards: Tell me about the last time this happened. What did you do next? What workaround did you use? What remained unresolved?
Blank worksheet: question asked; answer observed; leading wording noticed; unresolved question.
Available rehearsal: 5 minutes read the scenario, 15 minutes practise the interview, 10 minutes review the worksheet. No recording or external upload needed.
